known_false_positives: Closed non-vendor state-like properties with a bare string are deliberately guard candidates.
known_false_negatives: Alias propagation beyond a direct one-hop local const initializer is out of scope.
Dynamic/computed property access and arbitrary serialization layers are out of scope.

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: Outcome-first fixture and copied-install validation procedure
evidence: Only this state family uses the Compiler API contract.

agent_confusions: A global tsc is not acceptable; the launcher must resolve the fixture host package.
The generated guard must carry its own source rather than import the toolkit.
The stock skills add command mutates its current working directory, so run it only from a disposable host and never probe --help from the source checkout.

residual_risks: Only literal-union/enum property receivers are protected.
Only a direct one-hop local const alias is tracked; general dataflow is intentionally excluded.
No TypeScript ORM or serializer semantics are covered.
